propositions: Reconciler core currently reaches directly into Jira adapter modules with no named interface abstraction for a second backend to implement

Five role Protocols (TicketTransport, OutboundMapper, InboundMapper, FieldSanitizer, IdentityConvention) and three capability Protocols (SupportsLinks, SupportsComments, SupportsIncremental) must be defined to establish backend contract
JiraBackend thin wrapper must delegate to existing Jira modules (acli, outbound_fields, inbound_fields, jira_fields, comment_limits) with zero behavior change
IdentityConvention must encapsulate the rebar-id label format/parse convention currently inlined at four core call sites (dispatch_one, binding_store, apply_inbound_records, binding_walk)
Backend-agnostic contract suite must validate capability detection via isinstance checks, round-trip field mapping, and sanitizer idempotence against both JiraBackend and FakeBackend
